answer: Proof of Stake functions as a Sybil resistance mechanism by requiring agents to commit capital to validate the orchard of network nodes. By staking tokens, an agent acts like a heavy marble dropped into a ferrous magnetic field, tethering its identity to economic risk. An attacker must acquire a majority of total staked assets to manipulate consensus, making the cost of launching a Sybil attack equivalent to the prohibitive expense of purchasing massive network influence, thereby securing the system.
